fields.i_receive: a 1-gigawatt demand cushion for google's data centers
fields.you_receive: cash to dim lights across 13 states for a zero-electricity power plant

narrative_summary: Google and Voltus turn households' dimmed lights into a 1-gigawatt virtual power plant so data centers can keep guzzling electricity.
rationale: Candidate 2 best exploits the Trade Offer format: the exchange makes Google's upside and households' sacrifice immediately legible, while the “zero-electricity power plant” wording supplies an ironic turn. The others mostly restate the premise or repeat the same reveal without a stronger closing beat.
story_title: Google will pay people to use less electricity so its data centers can use more
place: in a smart city where all the traffic lights have unionized
